overloadMerges.note: variable is the doc's arrow-marked (←) output slot filled with the value sent by SEND VARIABLE; the draft parser had defaulted it to direction:in.

params.name: variable
params.description: Variable that receives the value; in interpreted mode it is created/typed on the fly if it doesn't already exist, in compiled mode it must already match the received type.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Receives a scalar variable previously sent by SEND VARIABLE from the document or serial port opened via SET CHANNEL, replacing variable's contents with the received value.

constraints: Only works with a channel opened by SET CHANNEL; documents opened via Open document/Create document/Append document are not supported.
Does not support array variables; use the BLOB commands to send/receive arrays instead.
In interpreted mode, an undeclared variable is created and typed based on what is received; in compiled mode, variable must already be of the same type as what is received.
The read interrupts on Ctrl-Alt-Shift (Windows) / Command-Option-Shift (macOS), raising error -9994, catchable via an ON ERR CALL method.
